_about: Outside dimensions of a golf grip, for the visual hand model (epic #15150, #15185). Distances are measured from the edge of the butt cap toward the club head. Only the two diameter stations are published figures; every key listed in `unverified` is a typical value that no cited source confirms.
_sources: https://golfwrx.com/280523/getting-the-right-grip-size-time-after-time/ (men's standard: 0.900 in at 2 in below the edge of the grip cap, 0.780 in at 6 in)
https://www.mitchellgolf.com/golf-grip-size-guide/ (the 2 in measuring station; standard 0.900 in, midsize 0.960 in, jumbo 1.020 in; ladies 0.850 in)
